subject.title: gateway tool not available to external-provider agent sessions

question: Should `gateway` be available to external-provider agent sessions when explicitly listed in `tools.alsoAllow`, and what live proof should gate a fix?
rationale: Current source suggests explicit profile policy should include the tool, but `gateway` is a high-power control surface and the reported xAI/Grok failure has not been reproduced on current main.

options.title: Require focused live reproduction first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main xAI/Grok external-provider session proves whether explicit `alsoAllow: ["gateway"]` is still dropped.

options.title: Document intentional restriction
options.body: If maintainers intend to restrict `gateway` to local/operator sessions regardless of provider-session config, close or update docs with that boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow regression fix
options.body: If reproduction confirms the tool is dropped unexpectedly, repair the shared effective inventory path and add regression coverage for the xAI/Grok case.

recommendation.title: Require focused live reproduction first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main xAI/Grok external-provider session proves whether explicit `alsoAllow: ["gateway"]` is still dropped.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman introduced the effective inventory surface that would need either the targeted regression or the documented boundary.
